# Game Engine Rules

- All runs must be played on the most recent version within the Hitman: World of Assassination (2021) game engine. (Renamed from Hitman 3)
- Submissions that are played within the Hitman 2 (2018) or Hitman (2016) game engines should be submitted to the **[Hitman 2 leaderboard](https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_2)** and **[Hitman 2016 leaderboard](https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_2016)** respectively.  

# General Video Guidelines

- Run must be posted somewhere that is unrestricted (no sign-in required to watch) and permanent (no expiration date).  Please use one of the following platforms if possible:
-       YouTube (Preferred)
-       Google Drive (Click Share -> Get Link -> Anyone on Internet can View)
-       Bilibili (Mostly for Chinese users)
- If video proof of the run is not watchable later for any reason, the run may be removed at moderator discretion.
- Otherwise suspicious runs with video skips/other visual anomalies including but not limited to frame drops, significant ghosting, excessively low bitrate, **or similar audio anomalies including but not limited to missing or inaudible in-game audio** will be rejected at moderator discretion.
- Otherwise suspicious runs with **[Recording skips](https://youtu.be/0NEguCJumz4?t=681)**/ frame drops/ heavy lag will be rejected at moderator discretion.
- Videos must maintain a level of viewability and the majority of the screen must be uncovered. Rating screen must be fully visible.

# Submission Guidelines

- All video submissions should START before the level or during the beginning cutscene and END with the rating screen.
- All speedruns must have SA, Difficulty and Timer HUD enabled/visible. Mini-map HUD is optional, but encouraged.
- SA and SA/SO submissions require a 5-star rating screen on Professional or Master difficulty, otherwise it will be relabeled as Any%. Any% speedruns can be played on any difficulty.
- All speedruns are timed and sorted by LRT (Load Removed Time) NOT RTA (Real TIme Attack). RTA can be included for full-game submissions, but should be left empty for ALL individual level runs.
- Most run submissions should NOT include ms, however if a world record time is tied 4 (or more) times our moderation team will convert that LB to ms. All runs with ms will be double checked by our moderation team regardless if you add the ms in your submission.
- ALL speedruns submitted with a time under 7 seconds will be required to press 'P' on the rating screen to show the score breakdown. This will allow us to accurately calculate ms for speedruns like Freeform Training Any%. 
- **Tranq glitch and camera FOV scaling via resolution stretching to the point where you can shoot through walls is not allowed.**

# Fullgame Resetting

- Any resets between starting the level and the rating screen (including cutscene) will have a 1 second minimum penalty. After 1 second the penalty is equivalent to the time on the in-game timer when you restart the level. (Ambrose explosion bug on spawn is an exception and will not result in any penalty for restarting)
- Bangkok and all Sarajevo Six levels carry a higher minimum penalty of 10 seconds to negate the advantage gained from spam restarting the level.

# NG+ vs NG Explanation

- Note that all runs (including "any%") on this leaderboard are New Game Plus runs due to historical demand, and difficulty resetting progress in this game for a true New Game experience. For something coming close to New Game speedruns, check out "Default Loadout" here: [https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_woa_extensions](https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_woa_extensions)

# Game Modifications Policy

### Allowed

- **[Peacock](https://thepeacockproject.org/wiki/intel) is Allowed (Peacock plugins/mods are NOT allowed)**
- Crosshair overlays that don't affect the in-game crosshair are permitted, but direct modifications to the in-game crosshair are banned. It is necessary for moderators to be able to see that the in-game crosshair has remained unaltered. If moderators can not prove that the in-game crosshair is unaltered, moderators can reject the run at their discretion.
- Third party FPS capping software (such as RivaTuner) may be used, but you cannot change your FPS mid-run with third party software. 
- Changing your FPS mid-run with the in-game graphics options (such as Vsync or Super Sampling) is allowed.

### Not Allowed

- **All Mods.** (as of Nov. 2024 rule change)
- Non-visible/non-game changing mods don't need to be uninstalled, but must be inactive during the run (ex. freecam and path tracer)
- Any third party cheat tools such as WeMod.
- Any macros that bind multiple actions to one button or key.
- **[Ansel Freecam](https://rentry.org/hitman3ansel)** (you can use it for routing and practice, but cannot be active during runs).
- **[Using Ansel to skip dialogue](https://youtu.be/z2-yAqbZu-8?t=94).**
- **Nvidia Profile Tweaker** (Tweaking the games visuals beyond the extent of the in-game settings menu via third party tools such as nvidiaprofileinspector, or editing the game's .ini files will not allowed)
- Resolution scaling past the boundaries set by the game in order to shoot through walls.

# General Etiquette (not a rule)

- **There is an informal expectation within the Hitman community to credit inspirations for your strategies. Please consider giving credit to anyone's strategies that influenced your run, whether that be in speedrun.com run description or in Youtube video description etc.**

categories.rules:

## Season 2 (no DLC)
* 6 missions of Hawke's Bay to Isle of Sgail
* Play in the order these missions appear in campaign menu

**If a certain level is not possible with the selected complication (for example fiberwire is impossible on Vector), then that level can be skipped in full game runs**

* **Note: No loadout and poison Romania are not tracked in H3 Extensions IL categories due to being redundant, but you should still do Romania with no loadout/ poison in full game run of that category. Similarly, default loadout Vector should also be done in a "default loadout Patient Zero" run.**

categories.name: Default
categories.rules:
**Make sure to read  "Game Rules" as well for rules applying to all categories!**

- Consider this guide to improve your viewing experience regarding the Category Extension Levels Table: **https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_woa_extensions/guide/4t5mr**

## Default

- Unless specified otherwise below (check for NG+/ NG category rules if applicable), bring ICA19/ coins/ fiberwire in starting loadout. If option is not available, bring no loadout.
- Any smuggle location in this list (**https://github.com/solderq35/hitman-tech-tips/blob/main/srdc/h3_no_mastery_smuggles.md**) is allowed. 
- Starting with briefcase in hand is not allowed, but you are allowed to pick up a briefcase from any of the allowed default smuggle locations above.
- Unless specified otherwise below, default start is upper left starting location in planning menu.

categories.name: Fiberwire
categories.rules:
**Make sure to read  "Game Rules" as well for rules applying to all categories!**

- Consider this guide to improve your viewing experience regarding the Category Extension Levels Table: **https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_woa_extensions/guide/4t5mr**

## Fiberwire

- Must kill Soders by throwing his heart in the trash can (do not shoot heart) OR the "One Last Time" kill (reveal yourself to Soders in suit).
- Must fiberwire Sierra out of her car, blowing up her car doesn't count.

categories.name: Accidents
categories.rules:
**Make sure to read  "Game Rules" as well for rules applying to all categories!**

- Consider this guide to improve your viewing experience regarding the Category Extension Levels Table: **https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_woa_extensions/guide/4t5mr**

## Accidents Only

- Blowing up Sierra's car while she is in it counts as accident on Sierra Knox 
- Any other accident on Sierra Knox out of her car is also accepted.
- Kill Erich Soders with **[electrocution](https://youtu.be/AP82KXFphxQ)**, **[failing the surgery](https://youtu.be/6shS-86Ya-c?t=555)**, **[KAI malfunction](https://youtu.be/TBPelYjAcl8?t=200)**, or propane.

### Edge Cases / Extra Verification

- Due to the game being bugged, shooting Rangan off a ledge to fall into cement pit may or may not be an accident kill; the performance HUD must be on if you use this particular kill in Mumbai

categories.rules:
**Make sure to read  "Game Rules" as well for rules applying to all categories!**

- Consider this guide to improve your viewing experience regarding the Category Extension Levels Table: **https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_woa_extensions/guide/4t5mr**

## No Loadout

- No smuggle points or stashes, or briefcase
- You are not required to show your loadout at the start screen, but if you use any starting equipment during the run it will be disqualified
- Any starting location allowed
- Do not submit runs to "Untouchable"; this mission is no loadout anyways so any submissions here are redundant

categories.name: Loud Ballistic
categories.rules:
**Make sure to read  "Game Rules" as well for rules applying to all categories!**

- Consider this guide to improve your viewing experience regarding the Category Extension Levels Table: **https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_woa_extensions/guide/4t5mr**

## Game Version / Patch Policy

- "Standard" category refers to runs possible on current patch, with some additional minor rules concerning glitch usage, **[read more here](https://github.com/solderq35/hitman-tech-tips/blob/main/srdc/h3standard.md)**
- No Longer Possible Runs are tracked here on speedrun.com under their own category
- Each NLP run has a helpful comment explaining why it's not possible, but here is more info on patch notes: **https://hitruns-wiki.vercel.app/docs/h3_patch_notes**
- The NLP category is an archive of old runs, please do not submit new runs here!
- NLP (Temporary) refers to runs *only* affected by boosting, and that are otherwise compatible with current patch.
- More Info:  **https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_3/news/3410**

## Loud Ballistic Kills

- All kills made with loud gun (Accidents caused by guns don't count)
- Kill Sierra Knox out of her car
- Kill Erich Soders by shooting his heart or his body
- Shooting telescope to kill Silvio Caruso is accepted.

categories.name: Poison
categories.rules:
**Make sure to read  "Game Rules" as well for rules applying to all categories!**

- Consider this guide to improve your viewing experience regarding the Category Extension Levels Table: **https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_woa_extensions/guide/4t5mr**

## Poison Only

- Use lethal poison (injected, consumed, inhaled via Shisha pipe, IV drip etc) to kill targets
- Use of **[bubblegum throw kill glitch](https://youtu.be/lWnQ_HNvgNI?t=28)** prohibited, due to still being red guns if body found.
- Must kill Soders by poisoning stem cells
- Using virus (either the one in the underground lab or the prototype in pirate ship model) is allowed on Francesca De Santis
- Emetic grenade/ device nor dart guns do not count for Owen Cage

## Ballistic Sniper kills only

- All kills made with sniper rifle (accidents caused by sniper rifle don't count)
- Kill Sierra Knox out of her car
- Kill Erich Soders by shooting his heart or his body
- Shooting telescope to kill Silvio Caruso is accepted.

categories.name: Explosive Devices

- Breaching Charge is allowed

- Emetic device/ grenade counts for Owen Cage

values.rules:
# Game Version / Patch Policy

- "Standard" category refers to runs possible on current patch. '"No Longer Possible" is an archive of runs that for one reason or another are no longer possible on the current patch of the game.
- Each NLP run has a comment explaining why it's not possible, but here is more info on patch notes: **https://hitruns-wiki.vercel.app/docs/h3_patch_notes**
- The NLP category is an archive of old runs, please do not submit new runs here!

# Rating / Video Rules

- Silent Assassin rating at the end of each mission.
- Suit Only means you start in a suit and never change disguise. Suits must be in **[this list](https://hitman.fandom.com/wiki/Category:HITMAN%E2%84%A2_III_Suits)**
- Rave On Suit counts as a suit in Berlin. It has **[same trespassing permissions](https://youtu.be/By4QRlEOeO4?t=167)**, counts for SASO in-game challenge.

- **Runs are meant to be single-segment. You are not allowed to load save files.**
- You can load save files to enable **[NPC Clipping](https://youtu.be/-iaWEkmj9ko?list=PLCe2j05dQZz0imgzKn1G5swnujlLrTIJi)** before a run starts, but you cannot load a save again once the run starts.
- **Run submissions that do not include the rating screen at the end of each successful mission completion will be rejected.**
- **[More information on proof policy](https://github.com/solderq35/hitman-tech-tips/blob/main/srdc/h3_reset_policy.md)**

# In Game Time (Time without Loads) Timing Rules

- Submit in game time to the "Time Without Loads" input field. For the rest of these rules, read "in game time" as equivalent to "Time Without Loads".
- Add up the time shown on the rating screen of each level to get the total in game time.
- Any resets between starting the level and the rating screen (including cutscene) will have a 1 second minimum penalty. After 1 second the penalty is equivalent to the time on the in-game timer when you restart the level. (Ambrose explosion bug on spawn is an exception and will not result in any penalty for restarting)
- Bangkok and all Sarajevo Six levels carry a higher minimum penalty of 10 seconds to negate the advantage gained from spam restarting the level.
- Consider using **[Livesplit](https://hitruns-wiki.vercel.app/docs/livesplit)** (scroll down to "splits" section) to help with time calculation mid-run.
- In addition to Livesplit, please use the **[Full Game Time Calculator](https://solderq35.github.io/fg-time-calc/)** when adding up full game time for submissions. Click on "Save data as Link", then paste the URL in your run description using the format `[Time Calculation](https://solderq35.github.io/fg-time-calc/...)`
- Please use common sense regarding in-game timing. The purpose of in-game timing is to prevent hardware discrepancies, do not take excessive breaks between levels.
- Do not submit full game runs with milliseconds- those are for heavily tied individual levels only.

# RTA (Time with Loads) Timing Rules

- Submit RTA timing of the full game run to "Time with Loads" input field. Timing starts when the first level loads, and timing ends when exit prompt is pressed on final mission.
- Note that runs are sorted by in game time ("Time without Loads") by default, but you can sort by RTA timing by clicking on "Time with Loads" on the leaderboard.

games.name: Hitman WoA: Category Extensions
games.rules:
# Game Engine Rules

- All runs must be played on the most recent version within the Hitman: World of Assassination (2021) game engine. (Renamed from Hitman 3)
- Submissions that are played within the Hitman 2 (2018) or Hitman (2016) game engines should be submitted to the **[Hitman 2 leaderboard](https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_2)** and **[Hitman 2016 leaderboard](https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_2016)** respectively.  

# General Video Guidelines

- Run must be posted somewhere that is unrestricted (no sign-in required to watch) and permanent (no expiration date).  Please use one of the following platforms if possible:
-       YouTube (Preferred)
-       Google Drive (Click Share -> Get Link -> Anyone on Internet can View)
-       Bilibili (Mostly for Chinese users)
- If video proof of the run is not watchable later for any reason, the run may be removed at moderator discretion.
- Otherwise suspicious runs with video skips/other visual anomalies including but not limited to frame drops, significant ghosting, excessively low bitrate, **or similar audio anomalies including but not limited to missing or inaudible in-game audio** will be rejected at moderator discretion.
- Otherwise suspicious runs with **[Recording skips](https://youtu.be/0NEguCJumz4?t=681)**/ frame drops/ heavy lag will be rejected at moderator discretion.
- Videos must maintain a level of viewability and the majority of the screen must be uncovered. Rating screen must be fully visible.

# Submission Guidelines

- All video submissions should START before the level or during the beginning cutscene and END with the rating screen.
- All speedruns must have SA, Difficulty and Timer HUD enabled/visible. Mini-map HUD is optional, but encouraged.
- SA and SA/SO submissions require a 5-star rating screen on Professional or Master difficulty, otherwise it will be relabeled as Any%. Any% speedruns can be played on any difficulty.
- All speedruns are timed and sorted by LRT (Load Removed Time) NOT RTA (Real TIme Attack). RTA can be included for full-game submissions, but should be left empty for ALL individual level runs.
- Most run submissions should NOT include ms, however if a world record time is tied 4 (or more) times our moderation team will convert that LB to ms. All runs with ms will be double checked by our moderation team regardless if you add the ms in your submission.
- ALL speedruns submitted with a time under 7 seconds will be required to press 'P' on the rating screen to show the score breakdown. This will allow us to accurately calculate ms for speedruns like Freeform Training Any%. 
- **Tranq glitch and camera FOV scaling via resolution stretching to the point where you can shoot through walls is not allowed.**

# Fullgame Resetting

- Any resets between starting the level and the rating screen (including cutscene) will have a 1 second minimum penalty. After 1 second the penalty is equivalent to the time on the in-game timer when you restart the level. (Ambrose explosion bug on spawn is an exception and will not result in any penalty for restarting)
- Bangkok and all Sarajevo Six levels carry a higher minimum penalty of 10 seconds to negate the advantage gained from spam restarting the level.

# NG+ vs NG Explanation

- Note that all runs (including "any%") on this leaderboard are New Game Plus runs due to historical demand, and difficulty resetting progress in this game for a true New Game experience. For something coming close to New Game speedruns, check out "Default Loadout" here: [https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_woa_extensions](https://www.speedrun.com/hitman_woa_extensions)

# Game Modifications Policy

### Allowed

- **[Peacock](https://thepeacockproject.org/wiki/intel) is Allowed (Peacock plugins/mods are NOT allowed)**
- Crosshair overlays that don't affect the in-game crosshair are permitted, but direct modifications to the in-game crosshair are banned. It is necessary for moderators to be able to see that the in-game crosshair has remained unaltered. If moderators can not prove that the in-game crosshair is unaltered, moderators can reject the run at their discretion.
- Third party FPS capping software (such as RivaTuner) may be used, but you cannot change your FPS mid-run with third party software. 
- Changing your FPS mid-run with the in-game graphics options (such as Vsync or Super Sampling) is allowed.

### Not Allowed

- **All Mods.** (as of Nov. 2024 rule change)
- Non-visible/non-game changing mods don't need to be uninstalled, but must be inactive during the run (ex. freecam and path tracer)
- Any third party cheat tools such as WeMod.
- Any macros that bind multiple actions to one button or key.
- **[Ansel Freecam](https://rentry.org/hitman3ansel)** (you can use it for routing and practice, but cannot be active during runs).
- **[Using Ansel to skip dialogue](https://youtu.be/z2-yAqbZu-8?t=94).**
- **Nvidia Profile Tweaker** (Tweaking the games visuals beyond the extent of the in-game settings menu via third party tools such as nvidiaprofileinspector, or editing the game's .ini files will not allowed)
- Resolution scaling past the boundaries set by the game in order to shoot through walls.

# General Etiquette (not a rule)

- **There is an informal expectation within the Hitman community to credit inspirations for your strategies. Please consider giving credit to anyone's strategies that influenced your run, whether that be in speedrun.com run description or in Youtube video description etc.**

values.rules:
# Game Version / Patch Policy

- "Standard" category refers to runs possible on current patch. '"No Longer Possible" is an archive of runs that for one reason or another are no longer possible on the current patch of the game.
- Each NLP run has a comment explaining why it's not possible, but here is more info on patch notes: **https://hitruns-wiki.vercel.app/docs/h3_patch_notes**
- The NLP category is an archive of old runs, please do not submit new runs here!

# Rating / Video Rules

- Silent Assassin rating at the end of each mission.
- Runs are meant to be single-segment. You are not allowed to load save files.
- You can load save files to enable **[NPC Clipping](https://youtu.be/-iaWEkmj9ko?list=PLCe2j05dQZz0imgzKn1G5swnujlLrTIJi)** before a run starts, but you cannot load a save again once the run starts.
- **Run submissions that do not include the rating screen at the end of each successful mission completion will be rejected.**
- **[More information on proof policy](https://github.com/solderq35/hitman-tech-tips/blob/main/srdc/h3_reset_policy.md)**

# In Game Time (Time without Loads) Timing Rules

- Submit in game time to the "Time Without Loads" input field. For the rest of these rules, read "in game time" as equivalent to "Time Without Loads".
- Add up the time shown on the rating screen of each level to get the total in game time.
- Any resets between starting the level and the rating screen (including cutscene) will have a 1 second minimum penalty. After 1 second the penalty is equivalent to the time on the in-game timer when you restart the level. (Ambrose explosion bug on spawn is an exception and will not result in any penalty for restarting)
- Bangkok and all Sarajevo Six levels carry a higher minimum penalty of 10 seconds to negate the advantage gained from spam restarting the level.
- Consider using **[Livesplit](https://hitruns-wiki.vercel.app/docs/livesplit)** (scroll down to "splits" section) to help with time calculation mid-run.
- In addition to Livesplit, please use the **[Full Game Time Calculator](https://solderq35.github.io/fg-time-calc/)** when adding up full game time for submissions. Click on "Save data as Link", then paste the URL in your run description using the format `[Time Calculation](https://solderq35.github.io/fg-time-calc/...)`
- Please use common sense regarding in-game timing. The purpose of in-game timing is to prevent hardware discrepancies, do not take excessive breaks between levels.
- Do not submit full game runs with milliseconds- those are for heavily tied individual levels only.

## RTA (Time with Loads) Timing Rules

- Submit RTA timing of the full game run to "Time with Loads" input field. Timing starts when the first level loads, and timing ends when exit prompt is pressed on final mission.
- Note that runs are sorted by in game time ("Time without Loads") by default, but you can sort by RTA timing by clicking on "Time with Loads" on the leaderboard.
